Sea cells whose transposed counterpart is a non-sea (NaN) cell contribute none of their baseline values. The full non-sea list is not printed (only the first 20 of 310), so these cells cannot be given as boxes. Target values of every sea cell do reach the mask at the cell's own position.","cite":["C8:L28","C8:L30-L31","C8:L33","C8:L63-L71","C5:L20-L24"]},"exceptions":{"status":"NONE","items":[]},"summary":"The saved mask (C10:L46) is the C8 mhw array. That expression also swaps lat/lon, so each sea cell's baseline values feed the mask only when its transposed cell is a sea cell."}
